runtime_validation.scope: Distribution template; customer-specific executions are recorded outside the package

runtime_contract_notes.list_projects: A registry attachment without a pinned version always runs the latest published module release, including later publications. For registry, active_project_version_id records the version at last activation. An accessible UUID can be read or forked even when absent from local versions.
runtime_contract_notes.read_project_version_files: Project attributes are in project.yaml or a file it references. Reading a truncated file is not enough to overwrite it.
runtime_contract_notes.write_project_version_files: Whole-file replacement in a draft. Supports requested agent-code and targeted project-attribute edits through a fork.
runtime_contract_notes.activate_project_version: Only customer_idn and project_version_id; no all/project_idn overload. Init event is project_publish_finish in current documentation; owner prose used project_publish_finished.
runtime_contract_notes.create_incoming_webhook: allowed_ips is stored but webhooks_service does not enforce it.
runtime_contract_notes.set_customer_attribute_value: Value is saved immediately; init-dependent effects depend on NAF code.
runtime_contract_notes.get_connectors: Returned connector api_key is not automatically masked; distinguish it from external credentials. Filter integration_idn+connector_idn replaces a separate getter.
runtime_contract_notes.create_customer: Before calling, keep only the newest customer IDN from page 1 with per 1. Standard creation starts a run and returns its state and any research steps. After an uncertain outcome, verify a candidate customer before retrying.
runtime_contract_notes.update_connector: Send only the changed settings. Omitted values stay unchanged. A targeted customer retest verified partial update and rollback with one field on the api integration and two WebRTC fields.
runtime_contract_notes.list_sessions: Results can be shortened. Restart pagination at page 1 with a smaller size if records are missing, then check unique session IDs against total for the same filters.
runtime_contract_notes.send_agent_event: Actor event. Pass the actor UUID as actor_id. The actor determines the integration, connector, persona and session context.
runtime_contract_notes.send_global_agent_event: Connector event without caller or session. Use only on an explicit request for a global event. OAuth2 init_mcp requires an actor event.
runtime_contract_notes.get_run: Poll the same run_id with after_step set to the last known step_count. Report only the new steps and retain the cursor when step_count is omitted.
runtime_contract_notes.get_customers: A detailed customer result includes portal_url. The current CustomerDto no longer declares billing_url.
runtime_contract_notes.delete_connector: Permanently deletes a stopped connector and its webhooks. Removing a phone or SMS connector can release its number. Use only within an explicitly authorized deletion.
